data.one_liner: Self-optimizing state management and dependency injection engine for Flutter with zero code generation.
data.what_it_does: Combines structured domain models with micro-rebuild precision using register-level CPU bitmask diffing. Allows you to update mutable state via standard cascades while rebuilding only the exact UI slots that read changed properties.
use_when: You want granular widget rebuilds without writing manual buildWhen conditions
You prefer structured domain models over fragmented reactive primitives without needing code generation
You need clean zero-wrapper route lifecycle dependency scoping
avoid_when: You strictly follow immutable-only state paradigms with copyWith
You prefer mature, stream-based architectures like BLoC or atomic providers like Riverpod
strengths: Zero code generation required for models
Surgical field-level UI rebuild precision via bitmask diffing
Lazy universal dependency injection with type-safe scopes
weaknesses: Relies on mutable state classes and cascade assignments
Alpha stability level with potential API shifts
data.setup_notes: Add graft and optional custom_lint / graft_lint package to pubspec.yaml, and enable custom_lint in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer predictable, stream-based, immutable state transitions with explicit events.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer compile-safe global providers and immutable reactive state graphs.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want a classic, widely adopted dependency injection and simple inheritance-based change notification system.
